engine: dolle_core/sim3d.py (rigid clumps; contact physics of dolle_core/collide.py)

sources.tubule: 0.5 x 0.5 x 1.5 in inner, borosilicate, standing (long axis z = rocket axis), wall adhesion factor 1.0: configs/mission_quarter_deck.json (T1, T2)
sources.materials: silica in one tubule, graphite in the other; values from dolle_core/materials.py
sources.n_grains: 100 per tubule: the value of the full simulator's flight campaign; DOLL-E's dust amount is not decided
sources.sizes: diameters from the 90-106 um sieve range with 90 % inside, log-normal centred on the band (the log-normal shape is ASSUMED, as in dolle_sim/sizes.py); the SAME sample in both tubules
sources.adhesion_scatter: factor exp(0.6 N(0,1)) per grain on the work of adhesion; pairs sqrt(f_i f_j), wall f_i: configs/mission_quarter_deck.json surface_energy_log_sigma, from the ~70 % scatter of AFM adhesion on clean glass (Rush et al. 2018, PROVENANCE.md)
sources.positions: ASSUMED: a compact released cloud, uniform in a 2 mm cube at the tubule centre, centres at least 1.06 x the sum of radii apart (the full simulator's spacing rule)
sources.velocities: ASSUMED: isotropic directions, speeds |N(15, 7.5)| mm/s, no spin. 15 mm/s is the geometric mean of the two grain-grain sticking speeds (6.2 and 38 mm/s), so the same start lies above silica's threshold and below graphite's
sources.residual_acceleration: 1e-4 g along +z (toward the nose): ASSUMED order of magnitude (PROVENANCE.md)
sources.friction: per pair from dolle_core/materials.py FRICTION (silica-silica 0.6, silica-wall 0.4, graphite 0.5)
sources.left_out: gas drag, the payload's 1 rpm roll, contact charging, wall vibration: notebook 06 section 9 gives each one's size

frames_note: every 4 ms step up to 0.5 s (slow motion of the cloud phase), then 30 per second; positions in integer micrometres

spread_start_for_comparison.note: the same grains spread uniformly through the whole tubule (ASSUMED positions): grains practically never meet
